code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated CRP and ferritin, and increased INR, suggesting significant inflammation and possible coagulopathy. Elevated monocytes and basophils may indicate ongoing immune activation. Low total CO₂ may reflect metabolic acidosis. These findings are concerning for severe infection or systemic inflammatory response, possibly with bone marrow involvement or suppression. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
